review_notes: No printed page number, no running header, no table title. printed_page 424 inferred from printed_page = scan − 3. This is the last page of the book's scanned range and the table fills it; nothing is printed below the grid.
Third column header is printed 'ጸራቅ ሊጦስ' (on two lines), i.e. ጰራቅሊጦስ spelled with ጸ and split into two words. Recorded as printed.

Same 15 rows as scans 425 and 426, continued rightwards (row 1 = ፪ሺ፩ … row 15 = ፪ሺ፲፭). Values are internally consistent with the ትንሣኤ column on scan 426 (ርክበ ካህናት = ትንሣኤ + ፳፬, ዕርገት = + ፴፱, ጸራቅ ሊጦስ = + ፵፱, ጾመ ሐዋርያት = + ፶, ጾመ ድኅነት = + ፶፪), which resolved the ambiguous ፮/፯ and ፬/፭ glyphs.
